title: Standard timer does not auto-submit
root_cause: Standard timer cleared without invoking submit/finalization.
db_impact: None; uses existing attempt and optional engine/revision paths.
evidence: phase2ExamEngine.test.js expiry finalizer; frontend production build
remaining_risks: Browser deadline timing and in-flight autosave not exercised.

title: Expired attempt terminal without grade
root_cause: Expiry branches marked terminal without score/count/breakdown calculation.
remaining_risks: Actual Mongoose atomicity and history recovery need isolated DB.

title: Late answers can be scored
root_cause: Submit used client answers with a ten-second deadline grace.
db_impact: No migration; terminal fields updated atomically.
evidence: Mock exact-boundary test proves late payload ignored

title: Wrong engine can score shared Attempt
root_cause: Attempt had no scorer discriminator and submit routes did not validate assessment format.
backend_files: Attempt.js; attemptLifecycle.js; attemptController.js; toeicController.js; attemptRoutes.js; toeicRoutes.js
db_impact: Optional Attempt.engine; legacy resolves from Assessment.examFormat; no backfill.
remaining_risks: Route non-mutation and legacy data coverage need isolated API tests.

title: Concurrent tabs can overwrite answers
root_cause: Standard lacked revision; TOEIC allowed equal/missing revision; read/merge/save was not atomic.
db_impact: Existing revision path used; legacy missing revision matches as revision 1; no migration.
remaining_risks: Real Mongoose race and browser conflict UX pending.

title: Student list omits attempt state/count/result
root_cause: Assessment lists did not return attempt state; TOEIC used per-test queries without remaining/count fields.
evidence: frontend production build; API returns active/count/remaining/latest result
remaining_risks: Actual list data mapping and pagination/load not checked in browser.

title: Submit confirmation omits unanswered question numbers
evidence: frontend production build; both pages list displayed question numbers
remaining_risks: Long-list layout and screen-reader flow need browser QA.

title: Assessment list has no search
root_cause: Student lists had type/mode filters only.
evidence: frontend production build; client-side title/description filtering

title: Single/multiple choice controls look identical
root_cause: Standard rendered clickable divs; TOEIC rendered radio controls for all choice questions.
evidence: frontend production build; Standard/TOEIC scoring unit cases
remaining_risks: Keyboard/screen-reader and live choice-array UI not tested.

title: Attempt limit feedback is generic/English
root_cause: Limit code/message surfaced as generic page/alert; list lacked exhausted state.
db_impact: No schema change; zero remains unlimited.
evidence: stable ATTEMPT_LIMIT_REACHED response and localized UI build
remaining_risks: Limit race and authentication interceptor behavior need API/browser verification.

title: Material download loses filename extension
root_cause: Display title was passed as download filename; originalName metadata was absent and client ignored Content-Disposition.
backend_files: Material.js; Lesson.js; materialController.js; lessonController.js; materialDownload.js; app.js
db_impact: Optional originalName fields; no backfill/index; CORS exposes Content-Disposition only.
remaining_risks: Legacy fileType metadata is not re-sniffed; browser-saved filename, large file, interruption, and protected controller stream require QA.
